summary.title: Reviewable billing handoff
summary.detail: Derived read-only review surface for a greenfield multi-stakeholder service. Billing ownership and authoritative rules remain unresolved; no decision is recorded.

goals.title: Prepare a reviewable billing handoff
goals.detail: Expose evidence, assumptions, findings, and an exact snapshot for human review before implementation planning.

goals.title: Resolve billing ownership
goals.detail: Name the accountable billing owner before billing rules can be authorized.

stakeholders.title: Sponsor / product owner
stakeholders.detail: States the product outcome and reviews whether evidence supports a handoff decision.

stakeholders.title: Billing owner
stakeholders.detail: Should define and authorize billing rules, but no person or role has been supplied.

stakeholders.title: Implementation team
stakeholders.detail: Likely receives the handoff; this is an inference, not a stakeholder statement.

useCases.title: Review billing handoff
useCases.detail: Sponsor and later accountable billing owner review canonical evidence, uncertainty, findings, and a bound snapshot.

behavior.title: Present a bounded handoff
behavior.detail: Proposed: review shows goal, evidence references, open findings, snapshot digest, and unresolved/proposed labels.

behavior.title: Missing owner blocks approval
behavior.detail: Proposed boundary: with no billing owner and no explicit human decision message, gate reports blocked.

responsibilities.title: Canonical dossier
responsibilities.detail: Stores discovery, use case, BDD, architecture, ADR, and review evidence.

responsibilities.title: Read-only review surface
responsibilities.detail: Presents evidence, labels uncertainty, and displays exact digest without recording a decision.

decisions.title: Keep the billing review surface derived and read-only
decisions.detail: Proposed boundary keeps canonical evidence authoritative and separates presentation from authorization.

risks.title: Billing owner unresolved
risks.detail: Critical ownership gap: no role can authorize billing rules or accept handoff yet.

risks.title: Authoritative rules absent
risks.detail: Pricing inputs, exceptions, and effective dates are unknown; criteria remain proposed.

risks.title: Human decision absent
risks.detail: No explicit human decision message is supplied for this presented snapshot.

findings.title: Billing ownership is not assigned
findings.detail: No role can authorize billing rules or accept handoff until Q-001 is resolved.

findings.title: Authoritative billing rules are absent
findings.detail: Proposed criteria must not be treated as confirmed billing behavior.

findings.title: No explicit human decision supplied
findings.detail: Thin gate remains blocked; no handoff artifact is created.

findings.title: Presentation ADR remains proposed
findings.detail: Read-only boundary is described but not stakeholder-accepted.
